messages:
marta: Heads-up — CI is red on the golden tests for PR #4821 (job 2984). I pushed a tiny serializer change earlier; suspecting it. Can someone kick a rerun?

ci-bot: Build failed: snapshot-matcher (job 2984). Artifacts: https://ci.example.com/2984/artifacts :warning:

alex: Which snapshot file is failing?

mike: prompt-render/assistant_policy.json. Diff excerpt from the artifact:
```
--- expected
+++ actual
- "assistant": "He said, \"Hello\""
+ "assistant": "He said, "Hello""
```

sara: looks like escaping got removed — probably the serializer unescaped quotes. marta, which change was that?

marta: I changed quote-escape behavior to avoid double-escaping in some older models. Commit 1fd3c9b. Didn't expect this regression.

alex: Quick triage plan: 1) rerun CI on job 2984, 2) if still red, try bisect by reverting 1fd3c9b locally and regen snapshots, 3) if narrow, open revert PR.

marta: tagging @eng-oncall — can you kick a rerun (job 2984) and attach the full failing output?

jen: Rerun kicked: https://ci.example.com/2984/retry/1 — I'll paste full snippet when finished.

ci-bot: Rerun completed — still failing (job 2984 retry 1). Full failing diff uploaded: https://ci.example.com/2984/retry/1/artifacts

mike: I'll do a local regen test. Command I use:
```
make snapshot-regen TEST=prompt-render/assistant_policy.json
```

mike: Local regen with HEAD reproduces the unescaped quotes. Reverting 1fd3c9b locally and regen produces expected (escaped) output.

sara: OK that confirms. marta — suggest we open an emergency revert PR and then follow with a proper fix that conditions the escape change on model version.

marta: Creating revert PR now and assigning alex to follow up with conditional fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4830 :shipit:

alex: I'll take the follow-up. Also, let's add a golden test for the quote case so it doesn't regress again. :memo:

marta: thanks all. I'll watch the revert merge and post once CI goes green. :eyes:
